_comment: Skills from other projects that pair well with this kit. They are NOT vendored.
Vendoring would mean carrying someone else's licence obligations, re-merging by hand
every time they ship a fix, and growing this repo by megabytes for files most users
never open. `node scripts/install-skills.mjs <id>` fetches one on demand instead, and
records where it came from in a NOTICE.md beside it.
The kit's own skills live in skills/<name>/SKILL.md and are always present.
Adding an entry: `licenseFile` is required. The installer refuses to install a skill
whose upstream has no licence file, because a skill with no licence is a skill nobody
is legally allowed to reuse — the same reason RAG-EVAL-VN needed one.

seo.summary: Audits and fixes on-page SEO: meta tags, Open Graph, JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt.
seo.why: Markdown only — no API keys, no MCP server, no subscription. Everything it does, it does by reading and editing files, which is why it fits a kit that installs nothing.

taste.summary: Design judgement for generated interfaces — layout, type, spacing, motion.
taste.why: Video templates in this kit are HTML and CSS, so the same judgement applies to a 9:16 frame as to a web page.

imagegen-web.summary: Prompts for generating design comps and interface imagery.
imagegen-web.why: For the cover and in-frame images a post or video needs, when a stock search returns nothing usable.

brandkit.summary: Builds a consistent brand kit — palette, type scale, logo direction.
brandkit.why: Feeds the theme system: a palette decided once becomes a `theme` entry every template reads.

mkt-context.summary: Foundation context: product, audience, positioning. Upstream says run this first.
mkt-context.why: Every other marketing skill reads it, and it is the same information a PLAYBOOK.md already asks for — fill it once.

mkt-calendar.summary: Builds a content calendar from a goal and a channel mix.
mkt-calendar.why: Feeds the queue this kit already schedules from, instead of deciding topics one post at a time.

mkt-video-script.summary: Video scripts with hook, beats and CTA.
mkt-video-script.why: The narrative half of a script.json — the kit already handles the render half.

mkt-ad-copy.summary: Ad copy: headlines, primary text, variants to test.
mkt-ad-copy.why: What actually goes into the campaigns the Pipeboard MCP servers manage.

mkt-ads-audit.summary: Audits a live ad account and says what to cut, keep or scale.
mkt-ads-audit.why: Pairs directly with the ads MCP: it reads the numbers, this reads the meaning.

mkt-design.summary: One design skill covering eight output types — logo, campaign visual, infographic, social post.
mkt-design.why: Covers the image side that `imagegen-web` and `brandkit` do not: campaign assets rather than interfaces.

_marketing: The six mkt-* entries are a selection from minhnv0807/ai-business-skills, which ships 63 skills across
marketing, personal branding and design, in Vietnamese (skills/vi) and English
(skills/en). Only the ones that plug into this kit's loop are listed — content
calendar in, ad copy out, ads audit back into what to write next.
To add another: copy an entry, change `path` to skills/vi/<folder> or skills/en/<folder>.
